title: String helpers
description:
Write five small string functions with the string library (no patterns needed yet):

```lua-norun
capitalize(s)            -- first character upper case, the rest lower case: "hELLO" -> "Hello"
starts_with(s, prefix)   -- true when s begins with prefix (prefix may contain any characters, such as "." or "%")
ends_with(s, suffix)     -- true when s ends with suffix
count_char(s, c)         -- how many times the one-character string c appears in s
is_palindrome(s)         -- true when s reads the same backwards, ignoring case and everything that is not a letter
```

```lua-norun
is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama")   --> true
starts_with("v1.2", "v1.")                         --> true
```
hints: `s:sub(-#suffix)` is the last `#suffix` characters, but `s:sub(-0)` is the whole string, so handle an empty suffix on its own.
A character is a letter (in English text) when its lower-case and upper-case forms differ.
unitTests:
test("capitalize", function()
    check_eq(capitalize("hELLO"), "Hello")
    check_eq(capitalize("lua"), "Lua")
    check_eq(capitalize("x"), "X")
    check_eq(capitalize(""), "")
end)

test("starts_with and ends_with", function()
    check(starts_with("v1.2", "v1."), "v1.2 starts with v1.")
    check(not starts_with("v1x2", "v1."), "v1x2 does not start with v1.")
    check(starts_with("anything", ""), "every string starts with the empty string")
    check(not starts_with("ab", "abc"), "a prefix longer than the text")
    check(ends_with("report.txt", ".txt"), "ends with .txt")
    check(not ends_with("report.txt", ".md"), "does not end with .md")
    check(ends_with("50%", "%"), "a % at the end")
    check(ends_with("abc", ""), "every string ends with the empty string")
    check(not ends_with("c", "abc"), "a suffix longer than the text")
end)

test("count_char", function()
    check_eq(count_char("banana", "a"), 3)
    check_eq(count_char("banana", "z"), 0)
    check_eq(count_char("a.b.c", "."), 2)
    check_eq(count_char("", "a"), 0)
end)

test("palindromes", function()
    check(is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"), "Panama")
    check(is_palindrome("Racecar"), "Racecar")
    check(is_palindrome(""), "the empty string")
    check(not is_palindrome("Lua"), "Lua is not")
    check(is_palindrome("No 'x' in Nixon"), "Nixon")
end)
